lead.title: OpenAI cuts GPT-5.6 Sol prices by over 20% for three months
lead.summary: OpenAI slashed API and credit prices for GPT-5.6 Sol by more than a fifth for the next three months, now rolling out to eligible ChatGPT Work, Codex, Pro, Plus and Business plans. The move lands as flagship model competition keeps intensifying.

top_stories.title: Starcloud raises $250M extension for orbital AI compute at $2.3B valuation
top_stories.summary: Starcloud added $250M to its March Series A for AI data centers in space, with Nvidia among the backers.

top_stories.title: RealMan Robotics to deploy 1,000 humanoids in kitchens and pharmacies
top_stories.summary: RealMan plans roughly 1,000 RealBOT deployments this year, demoing medicine and food handling at the World Robot Conference.

top_stories.title: Grok 4.6 arrives on Google Enterprise Agent Platform
top_stories.summary: xAI's Grok 4.6 is now available on Vertex AI for enterprise deployment, with Grok Bot also included in more plans.

top_stories.title: DeepMind recaps 15 years of game AI and expands EVE Online research with Fenris Creations
top_stories.summary: From Atari to EVE Online, DeepMind documents its game-based milestones and a new program targeting continual learning, deep memory and long-horizon planning.

items.title: SGLang Fast Engine Recovery cuts huge-model reloads to sub-second
items.summary: A new Weight Cache Daemon slashes weight-loading times to ~0.63s for Ling-2.6-1T FP8 and delivers ~500x speedups on Qwen3-235B via zero-copy CUDA IPC over persistent GPU processes.

items.title: Together AI to demo production serving of Kimi K3
items.summary: An August 26 webinar will cover production serving of Kimi K3, including architecture, quality and optimizations.

items.title: Nous Research highlights long-standing inference implementations
items.summary: Nous shared inference features it has kept in production for months; a thin update with no new model attached.

items.title: Schaeffler to mass produce humanoid strain wave gearboxes in 2027
items.summary: Schaeffler validated formed strain wave gearboxes for humanoids and will scale production in 2027, cutting manufacturing costs by over 25% and material use by more than 75%.

items.title: Galaxy Corp opens Seoul robot park with humanoid taekwondo showcase
items.summary: Galaxy Robot Park opened in Seoul with humanoids performing taekwondo, and hands-on programs for visitors to pilot robot dogs and dance with robots.

items.title: Humanoid robot crashes into wall during Robot Olympics training
items.summary: A humanoid training for the 2026 World Humanoid Robot Games in Beijing ran too fast during a run event, failed to stop and slammed into a safety cushion in a shower of sparks.

items.title: DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Vision-Exp adds image understanding with no vision surcharge
items.summary: DeepSeek's experimental multimodal variant of V4-Flash adds image understanding at existing token rates, with same-day support in DeepSeek Harness 0.1.1 and the Responses API.

items.title: OzBrain offers a shared knowledge layer for agents and teams
items.summary: Show HN: OzBrain acts as a 'shared brain' so multiple agents and humans read and write the same trusted context instead of siloed memory.

items.title: Heimdall gives coding agents trust-verified context
items.summary: Show HN: Heimdall is a knowledge layer that hands coding agents verified context so they act on trusted information rather than ungrounded model memory.
